freeCancellationDateTime.description: Free cancellation time in the hotel local time zone.

invoiceType.description: Invoice type: 1 - general VAT invoice; 2 - special VAT invoice.

payAtHotelFeeCurrency.description: Pay-at-hotel fee currency, using the hotel local currency.

pointsLabel.description: Points label: 7 - points eligible; null - no points.

baseCurrency.description: Supplier base price currency. Returned for pay-at-hotel products or when agreement-hosted customers are configured to receive original agreement base prices. Contact the business team to apply for this configuration if needed.

basePrice.description: Supplier base price. Returned for pay-at-hotel products or when agreement-hosted customers are configured to receive original agreement base prices. Contact the business team to apply for this configuration if needed.

saleDate.description: Sale date, returned in chronological order.

productLabel.description: Product label: 0 or empty - no label; 1 - agreement rate; 2 - platform direct contract; 3 - group room; 4 - fixed-price agreement; 5 - discount agreement; 6 - package rate; 11 - agreement promotion rate; 12 - preferred.

rapidProcessing.description: Rapid processing flag: 0 or empty - not rapid processing; 1 - rapid processing. Indicates the supplier confirms through a direct connection for faster confirmation. The actual confirmation result is still subject to the order confirmation notification.

ratePlanId.description: Rate plan ID, also the product ID.

ratePlanName.example: Mock domestic supplier - policy 4, free cancellation

roomPrice.description: Total room charge for the order, excluding taxes and fees.

settlementLabel.description: Settlement label: 9 - settlement on behalf; 10 - not settlement on behalf.

supplyCode.description: Supplier code. Must be passed back for trial booking and order creation.

taxAndFeeDetails.description: Room rate, tax, and other fee details. Applies to overseas hotels.

chargeFrequency.description: Charge frequency: nightly - per night; PerStay - per stay.

date.description: Sale date. Present when the charge frequency is per night.

type.description: Fee type. See the Fee Type enum.

tipsType.description: Tip type: 1 - selling point information; 2 - price package; 3 - special note; 4 - reminder; 5 - promotion information.

totalBasePrice.description: Supplier total price. Present only for pay-at-hotel products.

windowType.description: Window type: 0 - no window; 1 - partially with window; 2 - with window; 3 - interior window; 4 - skylight.

downstream_request_id.description: Glink downstream request ID. It is usually returned after a successful call.

X-OP-App-Key.description: Open platform App Key, which is `open_app_id` after the application is activated.
X-OP-App-Key.name: X-OP-App-Key

X-OP-Nonce.description: Random string, used to prevent replay; it cannot be repeated within a short period of time under the same `X-OP-App-Key`.
X-OP-Nonce.name: X-OP-Nonce

X-OP-Sign.description: Platform signature. The signature string consists of METHOD, PATH, sorted query, body's SHA256, timestamp, nonce, and appKey, and is spliced ​​by line breaks, and then the application secret is used for HMAC-SHA256.
X-OP-Sign.name: X-OP-Sign

X-OP-Timestamp.description: Signature timestamp. Supports Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds or RFC3339; the platform default check time deviation does not exceed ±5 minutes.
X-OP-Timestamp.name: X-OP-Timestamp

info.description:
This document describes how developers access Glink hotel APIs through the Open Platform unified authentication system.

Entry point: `/openapi/v1/glink/*`.

Required authentication headers: `X-OP-App-Key`, `X-OP-Timestamp`, `X-OP-Nonce`, `X-OP-Sign`.

Signature string generation rules:
1. Convert `METHOD` to uppercase
2. Use the request path `PATH`
3. Sort query key/value pairs and join them into a canonical query string
4. Calculate SHA256 over the raw request body bytes and use the lowercase hexadecimal digest
5. Join `METHOD
PATH
QUERY
BODY_SHA256
TIMESTAMP
NONCE
APP_KEY` with newline characters
6. Sign that string with the application secret using HMAC-SHA256, then use the lowercase hexadecimal result

Timestamps may be Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, or RFC3339.

Supplier-side `partnerCode`, `signature`, `requestType`, `timestamp`, and the Glink message wrapper are completed automatically by the platform runtime. Clients must not send Glink supplier authentication headers themselves.

Successful responses return `code=SUCCESS`; supplier business failures may still return HTTP 200 with `code=SUPPLIER_BIZ_ERROR`.

glinkHotelEvent.description: After Open Platform receives Glink hotel callbacks, it forwards all hotel async events to the single webhook URL configured by the customer. Use event_type to distinguish order status, guarantee refund or charge, invoice status, and checkout status events.

data.description: Business payload for the event type. Expand the event_type groups below to view field definitions. In the actual webhook payload, data directly contains the fields of the matching group and does not include the group name.

oneOf.description: When event_type=glink.hotel.order_status, data contains the following fields. Event summary: Order status event.

message.description: Status message, reject reason, or failure reason.

orderStatus.description: Order status: 3 confirmed, 4 rejected, 6 cancellation succeeded, 7 cancellation failed.

penaltiesType.description: Penalty type, passed through from Glink.

oneOf.title: glink.hotel.order_status

oneOf.description: When event_type=glink.hotel.guarantee_refund, data contains the following fields. Event summary: Guarantee refund or charge event.

reqNum.description: Guarantee refund or charge task number.

oneOf.title: glink.hotel.guarantee_refund

oneOf.description: When event_type=glink.hotel.invoice_status, data contains the following fields. Event summary: Invoice status event.

coOrderCode.description: Customer order number. At least one of coOrderCode and fcOrderCode is returned.

fcOrderCode.description: Glink/FCG order number. At least one of coOrderCode and fcOrderCode is returned.

sendStatus.description: Send status: 0 not sent, 1 sent, 2 failed.

invoiceStatus.description: Invoice status, passed through from Glink.

invoiceTax.description: Tax rate or tax amount information.

invoiceType.description: Invoice type, passed through from Glink.

oneOf.title: glink.hotel.invoice_status

oneOf.description: When event_type=glink.hotel.checkout_status, data contains the following fields. Event summary: Checkout request status event.

refundMethod.description: Refund method: 0 full cancellation, 1 partial cancellation.

refundStatus.description: Refund or checkout status: T0 pending, T1 following up, T2 approved, T3 rejected.

oneOf.title: glink.hotel.checkout_status

event_type.description: Event type. Use this value to determine which event structure under data applies.
